Transformer Protection 
 Scheme
 BT10 of unit 210 MW,
 type KTRT 18X20

This document outlines the 
testing procedure I1, which must be performed every 6 months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.

This patent concerns the test of Protection 
 Relays of home transformer, manufactured by SKODA and ABB ARAB . The 
 transformer is of type KTRT 18X20, rated power 20MVA, vector group Dd0, and 
 voltages 15.75 8x2%/6.3KV.

The first draft initiated 
 by eng. Maysa Ahmady, tested at 27 Jan. 2003 by eng. Iman Rizk ElAshry, 
 revised by quality control 
 engineer eng. Adel Abd El Kader EL Nagar of EDEPCo, accepted by general 
 director eng . Mahmoud Sakr, and approved by Eng .Mustafa Alaam Sector Head.

Inject current to each 
 couple of points till the red flag of the device displays.

Repeat the steps for each 
 pair of points either on L .T .S or H .T . S .
Record the results.

items:
Place the socket ZZ10 in 
 Z2, and another one in Z9 (HH01)

Fix the timer (element ) 
 leads in ( 172,193 ) at the rear of panel HH02 .

Inject the current to 
 points (11,12) then ( 12, 13 ) and finally ( 11,13 ) of Z9 phase to phase.

Inject the voltage by the 
 other tester to points (11, 12) then (12, 13) and finally ( 11,13 ) of Z2 
 phase to phase.

Fixing a value of 4.3A, 
 increase the injected voltage till the red flags indicating the injected 
 phases disappear (reset value ) then decrease the voltage gradually till the 
 disappearing flags reappear( set value of 1st stage ) . Let the 
 timer act indicating the tripping time of the 1st stage.

The tripping voltage (1st 
 stage) represents the S.C. impedance of 1SP.

Drive the 1st 
 stage device out of place.

Leave the timer leads in ( 
 172 , 193 ) at the rear of panel HH02 .
Repeat the previous steps .

When the flag of 2nd 
 stage appears make the timer start acting till it stops recording the tripping 
 time of 2nd stage.

Repeat the previous steps 
 for each pair of phases.

Repeat the results of each 
 phase phase.

Release 
 the leads of the testing instruments.

Check the return of relay- 
 wires and trip-leads to their original places and tighten them carefully .

Press the main RESET 
 button in HH01 for those devices in the control room .

Press the RESET button 
 for those devices in the 6.3 KV hall and check the relay setting .

Be sure that the relay is 
 completely ready for service any time.

Alienate the testing materials and equipments 
 in addition to the caution signs and leave the place clean.
Return the work permission.
